items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The first one I had was Duke Ellington, Roberta Flack -- she was hot then, she had made this big hit -- Cal Tjader.

ctx.x: If he liked it, I can't on wrong, I'm thinking. He said, 'I like it.' He said, 'As a matter of fact, you tell the guy when you go back, if he will accept this project as is, with a spectacular on a Sunday, that you doing it on a Sunday, you're doing it every night down in the theater,' -- and once a month, I had it once a month, every first Sunday of the month we would do a spectacular in the show room and bring in a big concert with Duke Ellington...I had a sample of thing down.

The first one I had was Duke Ellington, Roberta Flack -- she was hot then, she had made this big hit -- Cal Tjader. The second was Quincy Jones, and so-and-so, and so-and-so. Three acts, three names, to

And with the all time good, Just about each one had a big band, then a small combo, and then a singer. They all ran out that way, with combos and singers: Sarah, Carmen. Bill said, 'He'll love that spectacular. You tell him I said if he accepts that as it is, I will speak to my man at NBC and discuss NBC taping it for network TV,' he said. And he would be the master of ceremonies for the spectacular once a month. Because he thought that was fabulous.
